text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its prospects, not just whether I am above or below my purchase price; avoiding an admission of a mistake can keep me in a poor position.","Selling winners has felt satisfying, but taking small gains too quickly may limit returns; I should weigh the stock’s outlook before locking in a profit.","After buying Stock E and Stock A at higher prices, I should avoid treating a recent price rise as a reason to buy and instead make deliberate decisions based on evidence and portfolio risk."]}
